reference_character_images.title: Reference Character Images
reference_character_images.description: Upload character reference images as identity-critical anchors. Generated people must preserve the same face likeness, facial proportions, age impression, skin tone, hairline, hair length, hair part, hair volume/style, distinctive marks, wardrobe, and styling continuity rather than using a generic model face. For 3x3 storyboards, include the referenced person in some frames and require every intentional person frame to show a clear visible referenced face with the product visible for identity and scale. When identity cannot be preserved confidently, prefer product-only, hands-only, over-shoulder, back-of-head, partial-face crop, or detail shots instead of inventing a different face. Use as clear face identity anchors for recurring people; preserve the same face and avoid waxy, plastic, CG-looking, blurred, cropped, or identity-swapped characters across shots.

reference_product_images.title: Electrical Appliance Reference Storyboard Product Reference Images
reference_product_images.description: Upload เครื่องใช้ไฟฟ้า product reference images. These are the highest-priority truth source. The generated prompt must preserve the exact electrical appliance category, subtype, silhouette, physical proportions, component count, colorway, material, texture, finish, markings, labels, packaging, and scale from these images. Creative styling must not recolor, resize, redesign, simplify, or replace the product. Treat these images as immutable product evidence; never add, remove, stretch, reshape, recolor, re-texture, relabel, simplify, or redesign the product.

image_text_mode.title: Visible Text In Image
image_text_mode.description: Controls whether the generated image may include added visible text such as captions, callouts, infographic labels, headlines, frame numbers, measurement text, or comparison notes. Default is no added text for non-infographic styles. Info Graphics Realistic and Info Graphics override this default and require concise large visible infographic text. Physical product markings such as sewn labels, engraved logos, care tags, SKU stickers, printed dimensions, and decorative product text are preserved separately and do not count as added text.

cinematic_style.title: Cinematic Style
cinematic_style.description: Choose the visual style for the storyboard. Style affects scene, lighting, camera, and mood only; it must not change the referenced เครื่องใช้ไฟฟ้า product shape, proportions, colorway, material, texture, markings, labels, packaging, or scale. Info Graphics Realistic and Info Graphics intentionally create text-forward infographic layouts with large concise readable text; they override the no-text default while still preserving the referenced product. Default storyboard prompts should favor cinematic photorealistic product-film quality with dimensional lighting, realistic lens/depth, and camera choices that match Storyboard Guide plus Voiceover Script; style must not change product geometry, material, labels, colorway, scale, or character identity.

storyboard_guide.title: Storyboard Guide
storyboard_guide.description: Optional storyboard, shot brief, or video-shot guide from Media Studio. When provided, every generated frame prompt must follow this guide's shot order, timing, story beat, action, camera intent, เครื่องใช้ไฟฟ้า product-use intent, scale/context, and continuity while preserving product-reference locks.

voiceover_script.title: Voiceover Script / Dialogue
voiceover_script.description: Optional spoken dialogue, narration, or voiceover script from Media Studio. Use this together with Storyboard Guide as the primary shot-by-shot content source. Match each numbered/timed spoken line to the corresponding guide beat; parse shot markers even if whitespace is collapsed. Do not invent a different visual story. Product Detail / Product Facts and reference images still lock the real product, claims, scale, labels, character, and environment fidelity.

production_concept_details.title: Product Detail / Product Facts
production_concept_details.description: Optional product details, product facts, selected concept context, and claim-safety notes from Media Studio. Use this to lock real product truth such as product type, model, size, countable parts, material, color, scale, use case, audience problem, hook, and selling points while preserving all reference-image locks. Do not introduce price, rating, sales volume, promotions, or other volatile marketplace claims.
